script: c=$(cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max 2>/dev/null || echo none); m=$(cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max 2>/dev/null || echo none); echo "cpu.max=$c memory.max=$m" >&2; test "$c" = '200000 100000' && test "$m" -ge 3990000000 && test "$m" -le 4000000000
